description: Source code for Bluetooth GATT write operations and connection management in Zephyr OS, including MTU exchange, connection callbacks, and write command handling.

methods.name: write_cmd_cb
methods.description: Callback for handling write command responses, calculates and logs write rate.

methods.name: mtu_exchange_cb
methods.description: Callback for MTU exchange result, logs success or failure.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth connection establishment, initiates MTU exchange and security setup.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth disconnection, cleans up and restarts scanning if needed.

methods.name: le_param_updated
methods.description: Logs updates to LE connection parameters.

methods.name: security_changed
methods.description: Logs security level changes during connection.

methods.name: write_cmd
methods.description: Sends a GATT write command with variable or fixed data length.
